fusions.name: Second Coat
fusions.desc: Sprays musk at the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 4 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 15% for each affliction the target already carries (max 45%).

fusions.name: Tight Grouping
fusions.desc: Looses 3 jets of musk in a tight spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 10 damage, knocking its target back 2 tiles and leaving it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Glands Primed
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Nothing Wasted
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 6 mana. Once every 5 seconds.
